title: Federal foundation sources for AgentCannabis
scope: CC-03 licence, activity and role routing
CC-04 governance and engineering boundary distinction
verification_method: Primary official web pages opened and relevant provisions inspected; no site licence documents were supplied.
freshness_policy_note: 30 days is a proposed repository review interval, not a statutory interval or assurance that law cannot change sooner. Reverification is required at decision time. Access date and legislative currency are separate.
consolidation_limitation: The Justice consolidations inspected on 2026-09-05 display current to 2026-06-21. The interval after that date was not exhaustively checked against Canada Gazette and commencement instruments. This pack supports architecture drafting, not a certification of all law in force on the access date.
used_by_note: used_by contains intended roadmap consumers, not a claim that every consuming implementation is complete.

sources.source_title: Cannabis Regulations - responsible person, security and approved site
sources.applicability: Federal role and site routing; review section 39(2) exceptions rather than treating the site restriction as absolute.
sources.targeted_claim: The responsible person binds the holder and is accountable for licensed activities. Head-of-security requirements exclude analytical-testing and research licences. Authorized site/building and outdoor restrictions must be assessed with their express exceptions.

sources.source_title: Cannabis Regulations - sanitation and processing controls
sources.applicability: Contamination and competence governance; does not establish fire, pressure, electrical or occupational-engineering approval.
sources.targeted_claim: Section 87 addresses sanitation; section 88.1 addresses edible-cannabis worker competence. For processing holders producing extracts or edibles, section 88.93 requires contamination-hazard analysis and evidence supporting effective controls.

sources.applicability: Product-contamination preventive-control-plan review. The requirement is not a universal PCP claim for every cannabis activity.
sources.targeted_claim: Processing holders conducting activities relating to extracts or edible cannabis need a written preventive control plan. Required content includes hazard/control evidence, critical points and limits, monitoring, corrective action, verification and implementation records.

sources.source_title: Types of cannabis and industrial hemp licences
sources.applicability: Explanatory routing aid; individual licence conditions and legislation control.
provisions: Selling cannabis with a processing licence
sources.targeted_claim: Health Canada explains cultivation and processing differences and initial processing-sale restrictions. The page expressly gives precedence to the Act and Regulations where they differ.
sources.date_notes: The page details display 2026-07-09; this is recorded as page_modified, not original publication or legal effective date.
limitations: Guidance is not legislation and cannot resolve an individual licence's conditions.
The industrial-hemp regime was not independently audited in this source pack.

sources.source_title: Guidance document: Good production practices guide for cannabis
sources.applicability: Quality-system interpretation and examples; not a substitute for the regulation or a current product-specific testing review.
sources.targeted_claim: The guide explains GPP evidence and cautions that passing testing alone does not establish GPP compliance. Its displayed QAP discussion must be read with current section 88(2).
sources.date_notes: The page details display 2025-07-15; this is not a legal effective date.
limitations: The inspected QAP discussion does not state the current section 88(2) provision; use legislation for that point.
This pack does not validate every example, numerical limit or testing detail in the guide.
